text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened while taking a walk in the forest...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. An endemic species of this forest, the phantom mushroom...
I have finally found it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You did it...! 
Um, I have a bag ready for you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ah, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I also brought a wet towel...!
If you'd like, please wipe the dirt off your hands.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, you make for an exceptional assistant.
Though, what prompted you to follow me all the way out here?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, when you were walking through the academy, Tachyon-san,
you were staggering and looked so exhausted, so...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I wondered if there was anything I could do to help.
...Was I being a nuisance?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Not in the least. Rather, I am quite grateful.
I must give you something in return.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, you really don't have to give me anything...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Humility is a virtue, but excessive modesty is unwarranted――
I hear you wish to become an independent adult?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Eh...
H-How did you know that?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, in that case, this is perfect.
I shall entrust you with the body enhancement drug synthesized from this mushroom.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It is quite simple: by amplifying the growth hormone secreted during sleep,
one effortlessly achieves adulthood. That is the mechanism.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... it sounds difficult, but...
Doesn't that feel a little off somehow...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A sound mind in a sound body...
Why not begin by testing out the physical aspect first?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A-All right...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mnh... A phone call at such a crucial moment? How unrefined.
Hello.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...A tip from a regular student to the student council,
prompting an on-site inspection of my lab? This is bad.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Yup.
Well, that should do it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san?
Why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh hey, if it isn't Flower.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~, I was just taking a nap in a nearby field.
Wanna head back together?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder who Sky-san was calling
out in a forest like this...?
